ops.text: Variants on other color-code lattices, such as the square-octagon construction of Ref. [⟦new.B1⟧], shorten the distance-five stage by cultivating in a smaller code with fewer postselected checks.

Under the allocation $\epsilon_{\mathrm{NC}}=10^{-2}$ of Eq. (46), for example, the fault-distance-5 square-octagon cultivation output of Ref. [⟦new.B1⟧], $p_{T}^{\mathrm{out}}=4.3\times 10^{-10}$ at $p_{\mathrm{phys}}=10^{-3}$, satisfies Eq. (31) for computations consuming up to $N_{T}\approx 2.3\times 10^{7}$ states, compared with $N_{T}\approx 5.0\times 10^{6}$ for the Gidney fault-distance-5 entry ($2.0\times 10^{-9}$) of the cultivation catalogue in Sec. S6.2.
